season.evidence: Stored Jul-Sep; web results point to late July through mid-September, snow slopes persisting to mid-August; Peakbagger reports cluster Jul-Sep.

track.why: Reviewer: only route on the peak; its own described line crosses the Dumbell ledge to the Dumbell-Greenwood col, so tagging Dumbell is on-route, not a link-up. Logged Phelps Creek trail; segments Phelps Creek -> Spider Meadow -> upper Phelps Basin; Sep 16, in season; start 29 m / end 16 m from the trailhead pin, summit 13 m.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Jul 20, logged Southwest Shoulder; track also tops Dumbell: a link-up.
Aug 26 logged South Slope; Greenwood then Dumbell in one trip: link-up.
Greenwood/Dumbell trip, Dumbell the next day: link-up.
Phelps Basin camp trip also reaching Dumbell.

facts.text: Beyond the ledge, a snow or ice slope above a small glacial tarn must be crossed; carry crampons through late August and September, since a party without spikes turned back in early September.
Loose boulders and falling rock on the debris-covered ice beside the tarn in early September; cross quickly and one at a time.
Black bears feed in upper Phelps Basin from July through September; keep food stored securely at the bivy.
In late July the connecting ledge can be free of snow and the Greenwood side may need no axe, though patches linger and boots beat approach shoes.

In upper Phelps Basin the trail fades; in late July staying climbers-left to about 5,800 ft, then turning right toward the main drainage under Dumbell, worked well, and a bootpath beside that gully shows in early September. The access road is rocky, so bring some clearance.

notes: Every harvested ascent of Greenwood is a Dumbell + Greenwood trip (our route itself crosses the Dumbell ledge), so under the link-up rule none is assigned. If the owner allows Dumbell+Greenwood pairs for this route, best would be 2313859 (Sep 16 2023, complete round trip from Phelps Creek).
